_about: The New chat page at /chat, and the two chat entries in the left sidebar. The greeting name is not here: it is the first name of the signed-in teammate in src/data/teammates.js.
_greetingsAbout: Picked by the clock on the viewer's computer. Morning from 5am, afternoon from 12pm, evening from 5pm until 5am.
_skillsAbout: The / button in the composer. Skills arrive in Phase 2; until then it shows this note.

skillsPlaceholder.title: Skills are coming next
skillsPlaceholder.body: Soon you will pick a saved skill here, such as an account brief, and run it on an account or a list.

_suggestionsAbout: The chips under the composer. Clicking one sends it as the first message of a new chat.
